description:
Collection of 14 rough mineral specimens primarily composed of feldspar with visible inclusions of black tourmaline (schorl) and quartz. The stones range in color from off-white to beige, some exhibiting orange-brown staining. They have a coarse, crystalline texture with jagged edges and raw, unpolished surfaces. Black tourmaline appears as thin veins or small patches within the feldspar matrix, alongside quartz inclusions. Specimens vary in size and shape, preserved in natural condition. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects.

Dimensions: For size reference, the largest size is 2.5 x 1.5 inches

description:
Natural Crystal Geode Specimens Lot - 2 Pieces
Amethyst and Quartz Mineral Displays
This pair of natural mineral specimens showcases distinct crystal formations. The lot includes a purple amethyst crystal cluster featuring sharp terminations over a natural rock matrix, alongside a hollow quartz geode half lined with sparkling crystalline druzy. These natural geological display pieces make striking accents for any mineral collection, study, or home decor setting.
Items Included:
Purple Amethyst Specimen: Natural cluster of lilac to violet quartz crystal points with exposed rough matrix and celadonite basalt backing
Quartz Geode Half: Hollow geode specimen with a rough tan exterior rind opening into an interior cavity lined with clear and white quartz crystals
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in raw, unpolished condition. Both pieces display natural crystalline formations, textural variations, and rough matrix edges with no visible artificial repairs or enhancements.

Viva Bohemia
Karlovy Vary Spa Cup Mineral Water Sipper
Porcelain, Cobalt Blue, Vintage
Traditional Czech spa drinking cup (lazensky poharek) designed for sipping thermal mineral waters in the historic spa town of Karlovy Vary (Carlsbad). Featuring an ergonomic hollow handle that functions as an integrated drinking straw, this piece showcases a rich cobalt blue glaze accented with delicate floral sprays, gilded accents, and geometric border patterning.
Integrated drinking spout extending through the handle for thermal spring waters
Deep cobalt blue porcelain with multi-colored floral bouquet and script Karlovy Vary lettering
Fully marked on underside with circular fountain logo reading Karlsbad Karlovy Vary Carlsbad Original Viva Bohemia
Measures approximately 5 inches by 5 inches
Condition:
Decoration fully intact with crisp script and vibrant floral details. Free of chips, cracks, crazing, or fleabites along the rim, base, and spout opening. Glossy glaze finish preserved throughout with only minor shelf wear to the unglazed foot pads.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Title
: Crystal Collection Geode Amethyst Agate Lot 3 Pieces 6" x 4" Inches Largest
Color
: Blue, Purple, White, Gray
Department
: Collectible Lots > Rocks/Artifacts Lot
Category
: Collectibles & Art
Description
: Elevate your space or collection with this striking lot of three natural stone display pieces, each selected for their unique beauty and appeal. Included are a blue-rimmed quartz geode with a crystalline cave, a vibrant purple amethyst cluster with yellowish base, and a large, polished gray quartz standing specimen featuring intricate banded patterns. Each piece boasts distinct mineral textures, vibrant color bands, and naturally polished surfaces visible from all angles, offering an engaging visual experience. Perfect for display in a home, office, or as educational decor, these stones are sure to draw interest for their natural artistry and one-of-a-kind attributes. Each crystal and geode is left in its raw, authentic form, with polished facets where applicable, showing unique formations and details. All stones display visible natural variations and minor imperfections as shown, but are free from major cracks or breaks. See images for exact condition and features of each individual piece.

description:
Artist Unknown
Standing Man with Pipe and Sickle
Hand-Carved Solid Wood Sculpture
28" x 5" x 5"
Unsigned
This striking figurative wood carving reflects traditional African folk art sculpture, carved from a single piece of solid hardwood. The tall, elongated composition depicts a standing male figure smoking a long pipe while holding a curved sickle or tapping knife, with a textured cross-body pouch draped over his right shoulder. The artisan has rendered expressive facial contours, prominent eyes, textured hair, and incised hatching along the shirt and pouch, set atop an integral cylindrical base.
Carved from a single log of natural wood with visible tool marks and grain patterns
Detailed relief carving on the woven-style pouch and rolled pant leg cuff
Traditional folk art representation of agrarian harvest or palm wine tapping
Condition:
Very good vintage condition with an attractive aged wood patina. Features natural age checks, wood grain separations, and minor surface wear consistent with age and hand craftsmanship. Structurally sound and stands firmly upright.
